customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

As I understand it: Only I received the termination form, not my wife; We have both lived here for nine years and cannot find another home quickly; this is how I recorded it.

Regarding “family-home termination with a possible service defect”, my notes show: the delivery to spouse remains unresolved; for the request “check form, service, challenge deadline and extension”: I have included everything currently available to me; on “family-home termination with a possible service defect”, I want a traceable assessment; also unresolved: the landlord reason; that is the basis of my request.

I am specifically asking for: check form, service, challenge deadline and extension; in particular, I need clarity about the landlord reason and whether the records support an initial assessment.

I became aware of the problem on 04 March 2025.

Thank you for clarifying; Before acting I need to know the delivery to spouse; Only then will I know what to do.

Best regards
